snippet.title: The Scratcher - Official Trailer | A roguelike deckbuilder where your cards are scratch tickets
snippet.description:
Scratch to fight, push your luck for the JACKPOT and stop before you go BUST.

The Scratcher is a roguelike deckbuilder where your cards are scratch tickets. Every cell you reveal becomes an attack, armor or a spell, and every one of them heats up the BUST gauge. The question is never "which card do I play?". It is "do I scratch one more?".

🎮 Free demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5398720/The_Scratcher/
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/JYfjqnU4BV
📰 Press kit: https://the-scratcher.netlify.app

Made by Terra Somnia Studio, a solo indie developer from France.

---

Un roguelike deckbuilder où tes cartes sont des tickets à gratter. Gratte pour combattre, tente le JACKPOT et arrête-toi avant la BANQUEROUTE.

🎮 Démo gratuite sur Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/5398720/The_Scratcher/

#TheScratcher #roguelike #deckbuilder #indiegame
